integrity.attribution: The prior pairwise-plus-triadic oscillator model and classical cluster mechanisms are explicitly credited.
integrity.proof_kind: analytical invariant-subspace diagonalization and exact inequality comparison
integrity.unproved_limits: Nonlinear dynamics at boundary values, basin sizes, other equilibria and general hypergraphs not proved.

limitations: Only antipodal two-population equilibrium circles; neither global basins nor a census of all attractors.
Nonhyperbolic coupling equalities are not classified nonlinearly.
Distinct ordered triples, identical oscillators and strictly positive couplings are essential.
Independent validation and exhaustive historical priority are not established.
scope_description: Exact local dynamics and finite-size exponential-stability classification for anti-phase equilibria on a complete graph with mixed pairwise and ordered distinct-triad coupling.
title: Exact finite-size stability and re-entrant loss of antipodal states under distinct-triad Kuramoto coupling
